title: Taking Back a Ridgecrest Advantage Application Before Coverage Has Begun
content:
Where a member has put in an application for a Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plan whose coverage has not begun and elects to take it back, the application is closed off before it ever takes effect and the money standing on it is settled as the premium standing to the member's credit.

The reason recorded against the application is that it was taken back before the coverage was due to begin, the day coverage would have started is written up as the day the application closes, the money standing to the member's credit is written on the application record, and the member's own recorded request is marked as carried out. Afterwards the member never held that plan at all, and the credit is the figure that will be handed back to them.

### How the application is taken back

This is the member's own action. The tool `withdraw_pending_election_40acc444` is first unlocked and then handed over to be run by the customer themselves, rather than run by the representative.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `advantage_enrollment_id` | The reference number of the Medicare Advantage application the member is taking back, read from their enrollment record before the call | An identifier |
| `advantage_enrollment_request_id` | The reference number of the member's own recorded request about that application, read from their enrollment intake record before the call | An identifier |
| `premium_standing_to_credit` | The money standing to the member's credit on the application, in USD | A decimal number carried to 2 decimal places, rounded half away from zero to the nearest cent at the moment it is passed; zero is written as 0.0, and an empty value is not accepted |

### What comes back

A confirmation sentence naming the application reference number that has been taken back, the day the application closes as YYYY-MM-DD, and the money standing to the member's credit written to two decimal places in USD. The sentence is returned only once the application has been closed off and the credit written on it, so its presence is what indicates the call completed.

Success is the confirmation the member receives naming the application and the credit.
